image_description: A white minibus parked on an asphalt surface with a background of green trees. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of tinted side windows, and blue decorative striping along the side. It has standard van-style wheels and a visible side mirror.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, boxy silhouette of a minibus (likely a Ford Transit or similar chassis). The proportions are consistent with a vehicle shorter than a full-size city bus but taller than a standard van.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible. A continuous row of dark, tinted passenger windows runs along the side of the vehicle body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is significant relative to its width. The driver's cab door is visible at the front, which serves as the primary entrance in this configuration.
While the specific mechanism isn't animated, the panel lines behind the front wheel arch suggest a sliding door track typical of this vehicle class.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, consistent with van-based minibuses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a side-profile shot; the rear of the vehicle is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with a distinct blue stripe/livery running horizontally along the side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front and rear wheels are proportional to the vehicle body and feature standard hubcaps/rims typical of commercial vans.
The length of the windowed passenger area suggests seating capacity within the 4-10 passenger range.

artifact_observations.location: Side panel text above the blue stripe
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text rendered on the side of the bus above the blue stripe. While it mimics the shape of words, the characters are illegible and malformed, a common artifact in AI-generated images where text rendering fails.

The reflections in the side windows are somewhat uniform and lack the complex, distorted environmental mapping expected from real glass, appearing slightly 'painted on' rather than optically reflective.
